propositions: Source code comments contain unresolvable commit SHAs, run/thread IDs, and dated incident narratives that degrade over time, with 8 of 18 cited SHAs already unresolvable due to rebase-on-submit
A new detector must identify rot-prone patterns (SHA-like hex ≥7 chars, run/job/thread IDs ≥8 digits, date+incident-verb combinations) and enforce CI validation
All detector-hit sites must be remediated by either citing a durable ticket system ID, dropping the rot-prone token, or replacing SHA narrative with behavioral descriptions

The CI guard must accept qualifying ticket IDs (4x4 hex-grouped or word-triple aliases) and the 'context: external' escape hatch, while rejecting false positives like 'bug surfaced' and path-embedded aliases
Post-remediation tree scans must pass with zero in-tree escape-hatch suppressions, with the detector's own unit tests excluded via EXCLUDED_FILES tuple
The word-triple-alias acceptor pattern must reject file-path context to prevent false accepts on hyphen-joined filenames
